Irene Park: Quick check 10am: new contractor starts Oct 5, accruals pro-rated? They need Oct 11 off (company blackout Oct 10-13) for an urgent surgery. Only 6h PTO available.

Carlos Mendez: We pro-rate monthly. For medical-related time off we can either convert to sick with a note or record a one-time carryover exception. Manager + People Ops signoff required.

Irene Park: Manager is ok to approve. Which is faster to process before payroll on Oct 20?

hr-bot: Policy: https://redwood.internal/hr/pto-policy. For speed: manager adds BambooHR comment tagging @people-ops and asks employee to email medical note to hr@redwood.com. People Ops can log an exception and flag payroll.

Leah Kim: Im the manager; adding BambooHR comment now: "Approve 1 day PTO carryover Oct11 for medical; employee to submit note by Oct18."

Carlos Mendez: Noted. I will log exception EXC-20000 and ping payroll to watch for tag #PTO-EXCEPTION. If note before Oct18 we convert to carryover; otherwise unpaid/alternative schedule per policy.

Irene Park: Thanks, will follow up with employee and confirm once note arrives.

Leah Kim: Done :thumbsup:
